mapper.select: select * from Investment_Estimate_Breakdown_change where Project_ID = #{projectId} and state!=3

select isb.*,pro.P_Name as projectName, pro.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment,sd.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, pro.P_Apply_File as projectApplyFile, pro.P_Approve_budget as pApproveBudget, pro.p_record_amount as pRecordAmount, pro.p_approval_amount as pApprovalAmount, pro.p_project_form_type as pProjectFormType, pro.p_inv_total as pInvTotal from Investment_Estimate_Breakdown_change isb left join Pre_Project pro on isb.Project_ID = pro.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd on pro.P_Competent_Department = sd.D_ID where isb.id = #{id}
